messages.author: 44a2186b432ea666
messages.subject: inla.read.graph issue
parts:
Hi,

I am working with data in a secure environment and unfortunately cannot share any files. My code (similar example below) runs fine until I attempt to load the adjacency matrix (the bolded line). When I try to run that I get the following error:

Error in if (s[k] + offset == 0L) { :
                  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

Any insight on what is going on here would be very helpful. Thank you!

Beth 

Code:
#import shapefile
shapefile.gen <- readShapePoly("./LSOA11_London.shp")

#create adjacency matrix
temp <- poly2nb(shapefile.gen )
nb2INLA("London.graph", temp)
LDN.adj <- paste(getwd(),"/LDN.graph",sep="") 

#load LSOA adjacency matrix
London.adj <- inla.read.graph(filename=" LDN.adj")
image(inla.graph2matrix(London.adj),xlab="",ylab="")

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inla.read.graph issue
parts:
Looks like you have a typo;
filename=" LDN.adj"
should likely be
filename=LDN.adj
?

Otherwise, use the R debugger to step through the inla.read.graph code
and inspect the variables; debug(inla.read.graph)

Finn

messages.author: 43f18cf9ab7dee8f
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inla.read.graph issue
parts:
Hi Bethelhem, 
You could try changing the object name 'London.adj' to any other name. E.g. X<-  inla.read.graph(filename="LDN.adj"). 
That could be the possible reason for the failure. Otherwise, you may need to update the INLA using this link. I did face similar problem. 
devtools::install_github(repo="https://github.com/hrue/r-inla", ref="stable",subdir="rinla",build=FALSE). 
BW

Wubet
